payload.instruction: Assemble the CbAuditReport in canonical order (SCOPE / RATIONALE / PHASE_LOG / INVENTORY / FINDINGS / RECOMMENDATIONS / FINAL_STATUS / REPORT). Use silk's finalStatus (from silk run audit), not your own claim. CODE_CHANGESET MUST be empty (CB-AUDIT-INV-NO-MUTATION).
payload.expectedOutput: CbAuditReport with 7 named sections; FINAL_STATUS from silk run audit
